rationale: Architecture and packaging decisions already exist in Documentation/Decisions and specification/adr; the scanner requires a different exact Markdown path.
Session-end hooks are an agent-tooling convenience, not a deployed HTTP Guard protection control.
Both active Build/phpstan-http-guard.neon and Build/phpstan-typo3.neon declare level8; this checker does not consider those filenames. Higher-level coverage remains a separate recommendation.
No Infection configuration exists, but 18 actual targeted security mutants were killed and preserved. That evidence does not establish general MSI/covered MSI.
AGENTS.md is absent (AG-01). Each failed content/size/symlink check shares that missing prerequisite; these are not independent contradictory agent instructions.
No npm project/package.json exists; node_modules exclusion is conditional on using npm.
The actual skill says Netresearch permits admin emergency bypass. enforce_admins=false is not an error on its own; required conversation resolution is enabled.
No updater configuration exists at all; GH-06/13 cover the real gap. A Renovate-specific requirement does not mandate two competing bots once Dependabot is chosen.
Dependency auto-merge is disabled and no automatic bot approval is configured. One required human review is a valid organizational policy; adding automation is an explicit policy choice.
enforce_admins=false follows the documented organization trade-off. Do not convert this raw failure into a blocking requirement; review-thread resolution is true.
The extension icon is absent (NB-01), so its colors cannot be inspected. The same missing asset causes both color failures.
Every inspected production/test PHP file uses valid declare (strict_types=1); these whitespace-sensitive patterns require no space after declare. Actual PHP token/syntax semantics are unchanged.
Active PHPStan configs exist under Build/phpstan-http-guard.neon and Build/phpstan-typo3.neon. Missing canonical filenames affects discovery, not proof that analysis never ran.

Runtime capability checks use function_exists for required cURL/IDN availability, not unsupported method_exists version guessing. Actual version-specific transport dispatch is isolated in RuntimeSupport and exact tuple checks.
No backend UI needs screenshots. Introduction text exists in Index.rst; an Images or Introduction folder is a documentation convention, not missing functional instructions.
guides.xml registers Typo3DocsThemeExtension directly. Literal theme=typo3docs matching does not recognize the active modern configuration; actual rendering is the authoritative check.

API, operations/reasons, development and introductory chapters exist under different names. Standardized primary English/locale organization is authorized, but this list is not evidence that usage or troubleshooting content is absent.

The reported HTML belongs to downloaded third-party provider source documents in the address corpus. It is not served Fluid UI and must not be translated or edited to satisfy the check. Direct-command stdout is retained.

Architecture decisions exist in Documentation/Decisions and preserved specification/adr; the accepted paths omit these. Canonical Developer/Adr discovery can be improved without inventing missing decisions.
Actual root/kernel PHPUnit and PHPStan configs and real kernel/Core wire harnesses exist at other paths. Standard discovery is improvable; recorded successful executions remain valid.
No suppression baseline is needed for the actual zero-error level8 analyses. A missing PHPStan baseline file is not a code-quality defect and should not be added merely to satisfy a scanner.
No application browser interface or JavaScript runtime is delivered. Playwright/npm infrastructure is not required for outbound transport authorization tests.
The project runs its own actual targeted security mutation harness; lack of Infection is not lack of mutation testing. General MSI and covered MSI remain unmeasured.
Current verified fixtures/bootstrap use root vendor. Migrating to .Build/vendor is a coordinated convention change, not evidence that existing runtime tests lacked dependencies.

The required standard runTests.sh is absent. Existing wire harnesses use deliberately owned isolated fixture groups and serialize counter consumers; this failure does not prove a network-name collision.
Real native Core and kernel wire fixtures are provided in Build/Fixtures and Tests/HttpGuard/Integration/Fixtures, not Tests/Functional/Fixtures.
LibraryServiceFactory has no direct corresponding Service test. Compiled-container/bootstrap construction is exercised, but direct reporter/environment composition branches warrant focused tests.
